Sir,
Enquiries at lodging houses in Hankow Road have failed to
elicit any confirmation of the report in attached. The Liu
is probably the person whose arrival here was reported on
17th January last. On coming here he established his headquart-
ers at No. 101 Nyung Kong LI, and afterwards removed to No. 4,363
Yui Yui Li ( 百许里 ), Choong Woo ( 共□ ) Road, Chapei,
where he still is. Liu frequently visits Nanking and Soochow.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

敬启者：
经对汉口路各寄宿舍进行调查，未能证实附件报道中的任何内容。刘氏（Liu）很可能就是去年1月17日报道其抵达此处之人。他抵沪后，最初将总部设在宁波路101号，随后迁至闸北共□路（Choong Woo Road）余余里（Yui Yui Li，音译：百许里）4363号，目前仍居于此。刘氏经常往来于南京和苏州。

此致
敬礼
您的恭顺仆人，
警佐吉文斯（D.S. Givens）

首席探长
（批注：3月15日）

Sin Wan Pao.
11-3-18.

In the afternoon of the 9th the Military and Police received a report from a detective to the effect that a rising would take place that night, when the rebels would attack the military yamens and loot the firearms etc. Colonel Wong in charge of the Shanghai Garrison immediately issued orders to take precautions.

In connection with the discovery of a steam launch in Pah Lien Chink 白蓮 in November last, which turned out to be the boat used by the rebels to board the cruiser Chaoho, a compradore of a certain Navigation Company named Tson Chun Kung was arrested some days afterwards and taken to the Arsenal. He was released on security but failed to appear when he was wanted later by the authorities. The latter have now sent men to Ningpo to locate him. Knowing this, he paid a fine to the Governor through influential men and asked to have the Court to cancel the charge against him. This was granted. Chen has now returned to Shanghai.

Si Si Pao.

Sometime ago in view of the fact that Shanghai is a large commercial port and that the revolutionaries frequent the Settlements, the Peking Government appointed one Zau as a detective resident at Shanghai to make enquiries in the lodging houses in the Settlements regarding the movements of the rebels and to kidnap or assassinate them. Owing to inefficiency, this detective has been discharged and a man named Liu 刘 has been appointed to take his place. Nominally he is a detective of high rank but really he is the leader of an assassination corps. Liu is a native of Anwhui, was for many years a detective under Mei Tsien Yuen 梅錢元 and is well conversant with the conditions of Kiangsu and Chekiang. He arrived here from Nanking the day before yesterday, bringing with him a number of seconds and is now staying in a certain lodging house on Hankow Road. His movements are very secret.

The Shanghai City Magistrate has received an order from the Civil Governor of Kiangsu through the Shanghai Taoyin to prevent any destitute people in his district from going to other districts and to arrest any refugees arriving at his district from other places and send them to their native places at the expenses of the Government.

The 9 robbers who were handed over to the City Court for robberies they committed in the International Settlement were tried yesterday afternoon when Foreign Detective No: 196 O.D.O. Loh Kwe Sai 陸桂西 and C.I.D. Interpreter Zia Bai Tuh of the Municipal Police gave evidence relating the general circumstances of the cases. All the prisoners denied taking part in the robberies and stated that they made statements at the Police Station because they were tortured. The prisoners were then examined by an officer who certified that none of them bore any marks of wounds. The Magistrate then ordered the 9 men to be returned to their cells pending judgement and the Municipal detectives to return to their Station.

《新闻报》
1918年3月11日

9日下午，军警方面收到一名侦探的报告，称当晚将发生暴动，叛乱分子将袭击军事衙门并抢劫枪支等物。负责上海卫戍任务的王上校立即下令采取预防措施。

关于去年11月在白莲泾（Pah Lien Chink）发现一艘蒸汽快艇一事，该船后被证实为叛乱分子登上“巢湖”号巡洋舰时所乘之船。某轮船公司的一名买办宗春公（Tson Chun Kung，音译）在数日后被捕，并被押往兵工厂。他在提供担保后获释，但当当局后来需要他时，他却未现身。当局现已派人前往宁波查找其下落。得知此事后，他通过有影响力的人士向督军缴纳了罚款，并请求法院撤销对他的指控。该请求已获准。陈氏（Chen，原文如此，前文为宗）现已返回上海。

《时事新报》

此前，鉴于上海是一个大型商业港口，且革命党人频繁出入租界，北京政府任命了一名姓邹（Zau，音译）的侦探常驻上海，负责调查租界内各寄宿舍中革命党人的动向，并对其进行绑架或暗杀。由于效率低下，该侦探已被解职，并任命一名姓刘（Liu）的人接替其职位。名义上他是一名高级侦探，但实际上他是一个暗杀团的头目。刘氏是安徽人，曾在梅钱元（Mei Tsien Yuen）手下担任侦探多年，对江苏和浙江的情况非常熟悉。他前天从南京抵达此处，带来了一批副手，目前住在汉口路的某家寄宿舍内。他的行踪十分隐秘。

上海县知事已通过上海道尹收到江苏省民政长的命令，禁止其辖区内的贫民前往其他地区，并逮捕从其他地方进入其辖区的任何难民，由政府出资将他们遣送回原籍。

昨天下午，因在国际租界实施抢劫而被移交给县公署法庭的9名劫匪受审。期间，工部局警务处外籍侦探第196号陆桂西（O.D.O. Loh Kwe Sai）及刑事侦缉处翻译谢柏图（Zia Bai Tuh，音译）就案件的一般情况提供了证词。所有囚犯均否认参与抢劫，并声称他们在巡捕房所做的供词是因遭受酷刑所致。随后，一名官员对囚犯进行了检查，证明他们身上没有任何伤痕。知事随即命令将这9人还押候审，并令工部局侦探返回巡捕房。
